note: Hand decisions on which DLD developer entities belong to each board developer (register_joins.py project_spine, lk_xref job developer_group). A decision here wins over the rules. Candidates for review are written to data/identity/developer_group_review.csv at each run. Entry: {"group": board name or key ("Select Group" or "select"), "developer_number": DLD developer number, "decision": "accepted" or "rejected", "by": who decided, "at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": why}. Never delete an entry: to change one, add a newer entry for the same group and developer number - the last one wins.
